title: Peter and RoboBot
subtitle: An interactive storybook

pages.heading: Peter and RoboBot
pages.text: Hello, Peter! Meet RoboBot. RoboBot is a shiny, friendly little Robot who loves to play.

pages.heading: Hit that ball
pages.text: Stop that ball! RoboBot watches it go over the wall. Oh no!
pages.alt: Peter and RoboBot playing tetherball at home

pages.heading: Building a rocket
pages.text: Up, up, up go the colorful Magna-Tiles! Peter builds a tall rocket.  RoboBot places a red triangle right on top.
pages.alt: Peter and RoboBot building a Magna-Tiles rocket

quiz.q: What color is at the top of the rocket?

pages.heading: Oh no! The tiles tumble down.
pages.text: Oh no! Crash! Crash! Crash!  The tiles tumble down.  Peter laughs, and RoboBot spins its head!
pages.alt: Peter and RoboBot's rocket falls down

quiz.q: What color tile is highest in the sky?

pages.heading: Bubble Time
pages.text: RoboBot blows big, shiny bubbles.  Look at them float!  Can Peter pop them all?
pages.alt: Peter tries to pop the bubble that RoboBot is making.

quiz.q: I spy something red. Can you see what is Red?

pages.heading: Playing hide and seek
pages.text: Peter is playing Hide and Seek. Where is RoboBot?  One, two, three... look behind the big green bush!
pages.alt: RoboBot is hiding in the backyard

pages.heading: Peek-a-boo!
pages.text: Peek-a-boo! Peter found RoboBot!  RoboBot makes a happy 'beep, beep' sound.
pages.alt: Peter finds RoboBot behind the green bush

quiz.q: What did Peter notice hiding behind the green bush?

pages.heading: To the secret fort
pages.text: Peter and RoboBot decide to go to the secret fort.  RoboBot transforms into RoboCar.

pages.heading: Riding in RoboCar
pages.text: RoboCar gives Peter a ride to the secret fort.
pages.alt: RoboCar gives Peter a ride to the secret fort

pages.heading: Arriving at the fort
pages.text: The sun goes down when RoboCar arrives at the fort so he transforms back into RoboBot.

quiz.q: What time of day was it when they arrived at the fort?

pages.heading: Together in the cozy fort
pages.text: Peter and RoboBot crawl inside a cozy fort filled with warm cozy blankets.

pages.heading: Reading about Dinosaurs?
pages.text: RoboBot opens a big picture book. RoboBot tells a story about dinosaurs until Peter gets tired.
pages.alt: RoboBot reads a book about Dinosaurs

quiz.q: What has big floppy ears and a long trunk?

pages.heading: Good Night!
pages.text:
Goodnight, friendly RoboBot. Goodnight, brave
Peter. See you tomorrow for more fun!

pages.heading: Back to the Secret Garage
pages.text: RoboBot converts back into RoboCar and drives back to his secret garage.

options: He is afraid of the dark

pages.heading: RoboBot needs sleep too!
pages.text: RoboCar arrives at the secret garage. He converts back into RoboBot to recharge and to sleep.
pages.alt: RoboCar converts back into RoboBot at the secret garage

options: RoboCar converts back into RoboBot at the secret garage
